title: safety.viz nep-explorer data contract
description: Long-format laboratory data: one record per participant per measure per visit (NEP-DATA-001). Column names are supplied by the settings mapping. The nep-explorer reads the serum-creatinine records only, resolves each participant's baseline (an explicit baseline flag when configured, otherwise the earliest record), converts every record to mg/dL through the per-record unit table, and reduces each participant to one point: their maximum post-baseline fold change against their maximum post-baseline absolute change, staged on the KDIGO acute-kidney-injury criteria. Phase 1 requires only id, measure, value, unit and a way to find baseline — a deliberately small contract, so the scatter ports to a study carrying nothing but a chemistry panel. Records that cannot be plotted are counted and exported rather than dropped silently (NEP-DATA-005).

data.description: d3.csv()-style records; every row carries the participant, measure, result, unit and visit columns named in settings, one row per participant per measure per visit.

settings.description: Column mappings and rendering options; merged onto the module's DEFAULT_SETTINGS, so only overrides need to be supplied.

id_col.description: Participant identifier column; required in data. One point per participant, and the key the participantsSelected event carries (NEP-CFG-001, NEP-SCAT-004).

measure_col.description: Column holding the measure name; required in data. Matched against measure_values.CREAT to select the creatinine records (NEP-CFG-008).

value_col.description: Column holding the numeric result; required in data. Missing or non-numeric results are dropped with a counted, exportable note (NEP-DATA-005).

unit_col.description: Column holding the result unit, resolved PER RECORD against the units factor table. When any record's unit is absent or unrecognized the module refuses to guess: the fold axis stays (it is a ratio), and the absolute cut-line, the >= 4.0 mg/dL rule and the delta staging are suppressed with a note (NEP-UNIT-002, NEP-UNIT-003).

baseline_col.description: Optional baseline-flag column (e.g. ABLFL). When supplied, the participant's first record whose value equals baseline_value is the baseline; otherwise, and for a participant with no flagged record, the earliest record is used — by study day, then visit number, then input order (NEP-DATA-001, NEP-DATA-002).

baseline_value.description: The value of baseline_col that marks the baseline record (NEP-CFG-002).

visit_col.description: Categorical visit column; the tooltip's "maximum at visit" line and the baseline fallback's ordering (NEP-SCAT-003).

visitn_col.description: Optional numeric visit column ordering the records; falls back to input order when absent.

studyday_col.description: Optional numeric study-day column: the baseline fallback's first sort key and the tooltip's "maximum on study day" line. Absent from the vendored demo extract, so the line degrades silently rather than rendering blank (NEP-SCAT-003).

measure_values.description: Map of the short measure key to this data's full measure name. Phase 1 reads CREAT only; the map grows to the profile panel in Phase 2 (NEP-CFG-008).

arm_col.description: Treatment-arm column carried on each point for the tooltip; ignored when absent from the data.

stages.description: The staging cut-points, defaulting to the KDIGO acute-kidney-injury criteria (NEP-CFG-003, NEP-STAGE-001..004). Supplied members merge onto the defaults.

fold.description: The ascending fold-change (value / baseline) cut-points for Stages 1, 2 and 3. Sorted ascending on merge: the R source paints its chart from a descending ladder and stages its table from an ascending one, and the two disagree.

delta.description: The single absolute-change cut-point KDIGO defines (mg/dL). It produces Stage 1 only — there is no KDIGO Stage 2 or 3 on absolute change (NEP-STAGE-002).

absolute.description: The Stage-3 rule on the VALUE reached (mg/dL). A property of the participant, not a region of the plane, so it is drawn as a mark property rather than a zone (NEP-STAGE-003).

units.description: The mg/dL contract (NEP-UNIT-002). The fold axis is a ratio and unit-free; the absolute axis and both absolute cut-points are not.

target.description: The unit the absolute axis and the cut-points are expressed in.

factors.description: Multiplier from each source unit to the target. Keys are normalized on merge — trimmed, lower-cased, with µ/μ/u folded — so one entry covers every spelling and casing. Sponsor-specific factors vary, which nepExplorer warns about itself, so this is a setting rather than a constant (NEP-UNIT-001).

filters.description: Optional filter columns rendered as controls (NEP-CFG-006).

details.description: Participant-detail columns shown with the selected participant; null defaults to the participant ID plus the filter columns.

zone_labels.description: Whether the scatter draws the stage-zone labels (NEP-ZONE-004).
